# cpp-httplib (vendored)

`httplib.h` / `httplib.cpp` from [yhirose/cpp-httplib], version **0.54.1**,
copied verbatim from Onyx Engine's `third_party/cpp-httplib` (which has the
same files). `LICENSE` is that project's (MIT). Built once as the
`backtrack-httplib` static library; `server/` is the only code that includes
it.

[yhirose/cpp-httplib]: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib
